subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should the Trim OS packaged Gateway auth/config regeneration be handled as an OpenClaw core Gateway repair, an external package-owner follow-up, or held until logs identify the failing protocol frame?
rationale: The requested workaround and possible fixes touch Gateway device pairing and shared-auth boundaries, while the repository does not contain the package manager that allegedly rewrites config.

options.title: Collect proof before auth changes
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the sanitized connect frame, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

options.title: Fix core diagnostics if proven
options.body: If logs show a current OpenClaw client speaking the wrong protocol or returning opaque diagnostics, fix the Gateway/CLI diagnostic path without loosening pairing.

options.title: Route package config externally
options.body: If the only reproducible issue is trim.openclaw regenerating config outside this tree, keep core secure and route the config-management change to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before auth changes
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the sanitized connect frame, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across Gateway protocol compatibility, device-pairing docs, and package/release-adjacent Gateway behavior.
